messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **federal holidays** in Canada for 2023 that create long weekends.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekday, the adjacent weekend days are usually considered part of the long weekend. Some holidays are provincial, so the long weekend may vary by province.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|-------------|---------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday (observed Monday, Jan 2) | **Dec 30–Jan 2, 2023** |
| **February 20** | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, ON, NB, PE) | Monday | **Feb 18–20, 2023** |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Apr 7–9, 2023** |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **May 20–22, 2023** |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday (observed Monday, Jul 3) | **Jul 1–3, 2023** |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Sep 2–4, 2023** |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Oct 7–9, 2023** |
| **November 11** | Remembrance Day | Wednesday (observed Monday, Nov 13) | **Nov 11–13, 2023** |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Dec 23–25, 2023** |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day (BC, AB, SK, ON, NB, PE) | Tuesday | **Dec 24–26, 2023** |

### Notes

* **Family Day** is celebrated in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, and Prince Edward Island.  
* **Boxing Day** is a federal holiday in the same provinces as Family Day; it is not observed in Quebec, Manitoba, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, or the territories.  
* Other provinces have their own holidays that can create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. Jean Baptiste Day in Québec, etc.).  

Feel free to cross‑reference the specific provincial holiday calendars for your target regions. Happy planning!
